introduction:
**The Road to North Pass**  
*Introductory Campaign · 2 Missions*

New to Hexagon? Start here. In two missions against the AI, you’ll learn to move your units, use terrain to your advantage, and take on a fortified position.

The towns beyond North Pass are running short of food and medicine. A relief convoy is ready to leave, but enemy forces hold the river crossing and the pass beyond it. Clear the road before the first snow closes it for winter.
completionText:
North Pass is open. The first trucks reached the towns before nightfall. By the time snow began to settle on the road, the clinic had its medicine and the bakers were unloading flour for the morning.

You’ve completed The Road to North Pass, the introductory campaign for Hexagon.

missions.title: The Bridgehead
missions.briefing:
The Bridgehead

The convoy is waiting on our side of the river. The old stone bridge is still standing, but an enemy outpost controls the far bank. Take out its headquarters and the convoy can cross.

Use the terrain for cover and move your units up together.

Objective
Destroy the enemy headquarters.

missions.title: North Pass
missions.briefing:
**North Pass**

The convoy is across the river and waiting at the foot of the mountains. The enemy has pulled back to a fortified headquarters overlooking the last stretch of road. Beyond it, the towns have already sent people out to meet the trucks.

Look over the approaches before committing your units. You’ll face a stronger force here than you did at the bridge.

**Objective**  
Destroy the enemy headquarters.
